name: SAGE: Adaptive Recommendation of Spreadsheet Pivot Tables
abstract: We present SAGE, an adaptive system that recommends pivot tables for spreadsheet users. Our demo showcases how SAGE intelligently suggests pivot table configurations based on user data and interaction patterns, significantly improving productivity in data exploration and analysis tasks.

name: CompassLLM: A Multi-Agent Approach toward Geo-Spatial Reasoning for Popular Path Query
abstract: This paper introduces CompassLLM, a novel multi-agent framework that leverages large language models for geo-spatial reasoning. We demonstrate how our approach effectively handles popular path queries by coordinating multiple specialized agents, achieving state-of-the-art performance on various geo-spatial benchmarks.

name: LELANTE: LEveraging LLM for Automated ANdroid TEsting
abstract: LELANTE presents a comprehensive framework for automated Android application testing using large language models. Our approach significantly reduces manual testing effort while improving test coverage and bug detection rates, demonstrating the practical application of LLMs in software engineering workflows.
